headline: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Reports 18.39% Rise in 9M Pre-Tax Profit
summary: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N21.24 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, an 18.39% increase year-over-year.
why: Financial results for aviation service providers reflect broader activity levels in logistics, trade, and air transport sectors.

impacts.name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc
impacts.why: Growth in pre-tax profit indicates stronger operating performance.
